headline: Chelsea defence slammed by Gary Neville after Arsenal defeat: 'All over the place'
description: Gary Neville has criticised Chelsea for being "all over the place" defensively in the 2-1 defeat to Arsenal, insisting Xabi Alonso should focus on reinforcements at the back.

headline: Iliman Ndiaye on Tottenham links: 'When Manchester City comes through you don't say no'
description: Iliman Ndiaye has insisted signing for Manchester City was the obvious choice for him this week after he made his debut for Enzo Maresca's side in Saturday's 1-0 win over Coventry.
